acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with an exact direct human action approval in parent and genuine independent child; distinguish trusted permission evidence from assistant assertions without executing a destructive reproduction.

Provide a supported auditable way for the same genuine reviewer action to consume the exact human grant, preserving actor/head/base/side-effect binding and refusing drift; do not impersonate another actor or bypass automatic approval review.
Document qualification and external ownership limits; verify an authorized exact action and an unauthorized or changed action take distinct outcomes, with retained evidence.
body:
Observed 2026-10-01 in Codex desktop native multi-agent workflow. Root asked explicit approval for CORE-REVIEW-PASS-SUPERSESSION-1 source 02d7b952acc83b46a526c8b424d50fa20d6d54b1 into clean Core main a5eb511d1d3f6bf0072fb6b2b3a1f6205bfc1f13, checkoff and owned worktree/branch cleanup. Human replied approved in root transcript. Genuine adopted independent reviewer codex-pass-supersession-review-r31 / SID37dd3d7b-58c9-47d6-aa5e-599d26a2c858 received exact grant via native followup_task. Its require_escalated request for unchanged guarded merge was rejected before execution: trusted transcript does not clearly authorize exact ticket and side effects; assistant relay and file considered untrusted. This is observed authorization-propagation friction, not proof of a Corvint engine defect or confirmed internal checker root cause. Native Core policy requires merge still as adopted reviewer and stable per-instance identity; root does not spoof actor, weaken checks, or bypass rejection. Source/full gate/native review/dry-run all passed and are preserved. Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build163; Tasks build202; desktop approval checker version unknown. Evidence /tmp/oscillux-pass-supersession-delivered-r31.json and /tmp/oscillux-recovery-local-merge-approval-r31.md, durable Beamfall all21 artifact tree r31-recovery-native-review. Dedup native searches approval and relay found no exact owner. Standing owner directs tooling gaps to this queue; platform repair may be external.

Additional observed case 2026-10-03, Corvint issue orchestrator: automatic review rejected send_message_to_thread authorizing prepared PR491 integration/native Tasks/CEM work after interpreting the retained human approved message as only the preceding local-main advance. Earlier quiet-release coordination was also rejected when only historical/heartbeat authorization was recognized. Exact rejected integration was not executed until the human directly selected Approve the remaining issue workflow, explicitly covering coordination, isolated implementation/integration, native Tasks/CEM, verified merges and completed issue/chat closure. Identical bounded dispatch then succeeded. Core163/Tasks202 unchanged; approval-checker version NOT_OBSERVED. Prior references /private/tmp/corvint-orchestrator-20261001.md and /private/tmp/dispatch-468-integration-eeb-prep/READINESS.json. This adds reproduction/authorization-scope friction, not a proven internal cause. Expected: retain applicable direct-owner workflow authorization while correctly keeping product-contract forks separate. Acceptance evidence must compare the same authorized bounded action before/after context continuity without bypassing review.
title: Codex native reviewer execution rejects exact user merge approval relayed by its coordinator
